method: manual tabletop homography; approximate snapshot, not camera pose calibration
limitations: Paper is slightly curled with a torn edge and viewed at a shallow angle.
Lens distortion is not corrected. Projection extrapolates beyond the paper.
Only contact points on the table are mapped; elevated RGB pixels must not be treated as tabletop points.
Mug geometry uses the existing simulation cup size; height and mass are assumed, not measured.
Card and cable thicknesses are illustrative. Cable is a rigid static proxy.
The cropped container and partially visible blue printed sheet are omitted.
This snapshot does not update when objects or the camera move.
